title: Vampire musicals are BACK LETS GOOOOO @The Lost Boys: A New Musical #...
transcript: The way that if I didn't know that Ali Louis Bourzgui was playing David in this musical, I would not have recognised him in this photo. This is perfect. We got our first look of the character design for Michael, David and star in the Lost Boys musical, and they freaking nailed this. This is kind of our first confirmation that it looks like they're keeping the 80s setting for the musical that was in the film, which, thank goodness, then you don't have to deal with technology. All three characters are reminiscent of their film counterparts, and yet they've each been given a fresh look that still embodies the vibes of the characters. And it's a little more flamboyant, which is gonna play really well on stage, especially a stage as big as the Palace. This was already one of my most anticipated of the season just because of the fact that it's such a wild card in this season. We really don't know what to expect. But after hearing the first of the three singles that they dropped, plus this first look, plus the fact that there's aerial designers attached to this project, so there will be flying in the palace, I am pumped for this. At this point, I am convinced that this is either going to be the best new musical by far or the next Spider-Man: Turn Off the dark, which, for all of its flaws, is an iconic piece of musical theatre history. So I cannot wait for this
